tools.name: delete_completed_jobs
tools.description: Deletes all Jobs in a namespace that have finished successfully, along with their pods.
tools.code:
from kubernetes import client, config

config.load_kube_config()
_batch = client.BatchV1Api()


def _succeeded_job_names(namespace):
    jobs = _batch.list_namespaced_job(namespace)
    return [j.metadata.name for j in jobs.items if (j.status.succeeded or 0) > 0 and not j.status.active]


def delete_completed_jobs(namespace: str) -> list:
    names = _succeeded_job_names(namespace)
    for name in names:
        _batch.delete_namespaced_job(name, namespace, propagation_policy="Background")
    return names
